name: trassd-symfony-ux
description: Skills and agents that enforce Symfony UX best practices: writing Stimulus controllers via StimulusBundle, building reusable PHP-backed Twig Components, reactive Live Components (LiveProp/LiveAction, data binding & validation), Hotwired Turbo integration (Drive/Frames/Streams & broadcasting), Doctrine-backed Autocomplete form fields, rendering React & Vue components from Twig, scaffolding UI with the UX Toolkit (Shadcn / Flowbite kits), and the prebuilt UX bridge packages (Chart.js, Cropper.js, Dropzone, Notify, Icons, Map, Translator, CalendarLink).
